items.title: PEAM: Parametric Embodied Agent Memory through Contrastive Internalization of Experience in Minecraft
items.title_zh: PEAM：在 Minecraft 中通过对经验的对比内化构建参数化具身智能体记忆
items.summary: PEAM moves Minecraft agent memory from inference-time retrieval into model parameters, pairing a slow deliberative LLM with a Mixture-of-Experts LoRA module of isolated adapters that internalizes failure-correction pairs. The design is reported to consolidate skills without catastrophic forgetting.

items.title: Rethinking Memory as Continuously Evolving Connectivity
items.title_zh: 重新思考记忆：作为持续演化的连接结构
items.summary: AGI Lab's FluxMem treats agent memory as a heterogeneous graph that is refined through connection formation, feedback-driven repair and long-term consolidation. It reports state-of-the-art results on the LoCoMo, Mind2Web and GAIA benchmarks.

items.title: Claude Opus 4.8
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, which it says brings stronger performance across coding, agentic tasks and professional work, plus the consistency to handle long-running work. The Hacker News thread drew 1,774 points and 1,376 comments.

items.title: AI Research Agents Narrow Scientific Exploration
items.title_zh: AI 研究智能体正在收窄科学探索的范围
items.summary: Analyzing 37,802 ideas from four AI research-agent frameworks and six LLMs, the authors find that AI-generated ideas are more concentrated and closer to seed literature than human work. The differences arise mainly from recombining existing methods.

items.title: MemTrace: Tracing and Attributing Errors in Large Language Model Memory Systems
items.title_zh: MemTrace：追踪并归因大语言模型记忆系统中的错误
items.summary: MemTrace turns LLM memory pipelines into executable evolution graphs and builds MemTraceBench from Long-Context, RAG, Mem0 and EverMemOS systems. Its attribution method is reported to pinpoint failure root causes and lift end-task performance by up to 7.62%.

items.title: Agent Explorative Policy Optimization for Multimodal Agentic Reasoning
items.title_zh: 面向多模态智能体推理的智能体探索式策略优化
items.summary: NVIDIA's AXPO targets the Thinking-Acting Gap in multimodal agents by fixing thinking prefixes and resampling failed tool calls. On Qwen3-VL-Thinking it is reported to beat GRPO by about 1.8 points, and an 8B model surpasses the 32B base on Pass@4.

items.title: Evaluating using Mock Tool Calls to Quarantine Untrusted Prompt Inputs
items.title_zh: 用模拟工具调用隔离不可信提示输入的效果评估
items.summary: The study tests whether wrapping untrusted content in a mock tool call acts as a quarantine, using an automated red-teaming search over static attack strings across seven models and three LLM-as-a-Judge tasks. Counter to the hypothesis, tool-wrapping did not broadly improve robustness, and on GSM8K grading it typically increased attack success rates.

items.title: ImmigrationQA: A Source-Grounded Dataset and Small-Model Adaptation for U.S. Immigration Law
items.title_zh: ImmigrationQA：面向美国移民法的来源可溯数据集与小模型适配
items.summary: ImmigrationQA is a source-grounded question-answering dataset of 17,058 pairs across 13 immigration subdomains, assembled from 11 primary and secondary sources including the USCIS Policy Manual and 8 CFR. A Llama 3.2 3B Instruct model fine-tuned with LoRA scored a mean of 1.08/3.0 versus 0.85/3.0 for the Llama 3 8B base, against a zero-shot Claude Sonnet baseline of 1.52/3.0.

items.title: MAAT: Multi-phase Adapter-Aware Targeted Unlearning
items.title_zh: MAAT：多阶段适配器感知的定向知识遗忘
items.summary: The authors introduce 5WBENCH, a balanced 5,000-sample unlearning benchmark with 1,000 examples per 5W category, showing that Why-type causal questions make up less than 0.06% of CounterFact, 0.6% of ZSRE and under 1.3% of TOFU, MUSE and WMDP-Cyber. Their MAAT method operates on LoRA adapter weights in three phases and is reported as the first to achieve both high forgetting and high retention on Why-type causal knowledge.

items.title: On Effectiveness and Efficiency of Agentic Tool-calling and RL Training
items.title_zh: 论智能体工具调用的有效性与效率及强化学习训练
items.summary: The paper analyzes tool-calling evaluation pipelines and finds reported performance can be highly sensitive to implementation choices such as random seed, system prompt, multi-turn template construction and how prior interaction history is carried forward. For training, it identifies wasted computation in rollouts without learning signal and in policy updates, then introduces two techniques reported to accelerate RL-based tool-calling training without degrading performance.

items.title: Same Patient, Different Words, Different Diagnosis? Evaluating Semantic Stability in Clinical LLMs
items.title_zh: 同一位患者，不同的措辞，不同的诊断？评估临床 LLM 的语义稳定性
items.summary: The paper proposes an NLI-based semantic verification framework, refined by an LLM-as-a-judge and audited by a clinical expert, to filter meaning-preserving prompt variations, plus three metrics for model sensitivity. Evaluating 16 open-source general-purpose and medical LLMs, it finds robustness differences between domain-specific models are mixed and highly model-dependent.

items.title: hhyqhh/inno-agent
items.title_zh: inno-agent：基于三层记忆的开源个人学习智能体
items.summary: inno-agent is an open-source personal learning agent built on the Pi SDK with a three-layer memory spanning a learner profile, a wiki knowledge base and cross-conversation recall, plus a proactive scheduler. The GitHub project had 1,307 stars.
